newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 4.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Friday, as reported by Kyodo news agency:
-- Major electronics firms to boost their own power generation capacity as part of energy efficiency campaign.
-- Science and Technology Agency's documents says prototype fast-breeder reactor Monju gripped with safety problems.
-- Oil spill cleanup will be completed soon.
